decision.name: 中集集团
reasoning: The broad-news export signal led to a specialist-verified physical container shortage rather than a sector-preselected search.
CIMC is a direct second-order bottleneck expression and Q3 results confirmed that the recovery had already converted into company earnings.
The 20d/60d excess returns of about +21.8pp/+29.4pp indicate substantial absorption, so the signal is not clean enough for Primary.
The obvious carrier control was even more absorbed; the automation expression had weaker event-specific conversion.
